agents.title: AI agents
agents.description: Create assistants with their own personality, tone and instructions, and assign them to your channels. e.g. "Sofia" for customer care and "Leo" for sales.
agents.readOnly: Only admins can create or change agents.

empty.title: You don't have any AI agents yet
empty.description: An agent answers your customers automatically with the tone and rules you define, and hands the conversation to a person when needed.

agents.deleteDescriptionUsed: {count} channel(s) use it; they'll be left without an agent and handled by humans only. This can't be undone.
agents.editorDescription: Define who it is, how it talks and what it can do.

field.name: Name
field.personaPlaceholder: e.g. Sofia, the barbershop's friendly receptionist. Uses emojis sparingly and always calls the customer by name.
field.instructionsPlaceholder:
What to do and what not to. e.g.:
- Always offer the haircut + beard bundle.
- Never promise discounts.
- Wholesale price questions go to a sales rep.
field.instructionsHelp: Business info (services, hours, FAQs) is added automatically; write this agent's own rules here.
field.greetingPlaceholder: e.g. Hi! I'm Sofia 😊 How can I help?
field.businessHoursOnlyHelp: Outside business hours it sends the message below and leaves the conversation to your team.
field.afterHoursPlaceholder: e.g. We're closed right now; we'll reply tomorrow from 9:00.
field.escalation: Words that hand over to a person
field.escalationPlaceholder: Type and press Enter or comma
field.escalationHelp: If the customer writes any of them, the agent stops replying and notifies your team.

skillHint.faq: Answers with the business info and FAQs.
skillHint.catalog: Finds products and shares prices and photos.
skillHint.orders: Takes orders and checks their status.
skillHint.handover: Transfers the conversation to your team when needed.
skillHint.router: Detects the intent and transfers to the right agent.

create.title: New agent
create.description: Pick a starting point. You can change everything later.
create.blankDescription: Start from scratch with your own instructions.

page.noChannels: It doesn't answer any channel yet.

training.title: Training context
training.description: Write what the agent must know about your business: products or services, prices, policies, delivery areas, FAQs and how you want it to talk. It is its main source: it answers from this and doesn't invent beyond it.
training.placeholder:
Example:
• We are a bakery downtown, open Monday to Saturday 9 am to 8 pm.
• Custom cakes need 48 hours' notice and a 50% deposit.
• Delivery to the north side for $5.
• Sugar-free cakes: yes, on request.
• Be friendly and use emojis sparingly.
training.tip1: Use short, concrete sentences, one idea per line.
training.tip2: Include exact prices, hours and conditions: the agent will repeat them as written.
training.tip3: After saving, try it in the Test tab with real customer questions.
training.alsoUses: Besides this text, the agent already knows the hours, services, catalog and FAQs set up in the system.

test.transfer: The agent would hand the conversation to {name}.
test.error: The agent couldn't answer. Try again.
test.noProvider: No AI provider is configured on the platform.
